summary: Frontend-only smoke + critical-flow test of SHINOBI ARENA Expo web preview. Validated home, profile, menu card (Cards & O C.T tabs), card/CT creation, arena chips (time hidden on Boss), battle init alerts/selection, battle turn header, Passar message, persistence after reload, and absence of NaN/Infinity/undefined across screens. All targeted flows passed.

issues: Deprecation warnings in console for shadow*, textShadow*, props.pointerEvents (non-blocking, but should migrate to boxShadow/textShadow/style.pointerEvents to stay future-proof)

action_items: Optional: migrate shadow*/textShadow* style props to boxShadow/textShadow and replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.

Optional: add testIDs to the Alert.alert buttons (RN-Web renders Alert as a custom modal, not window.confirm). This would allow Playwright to confirm 'Encerrar' end-battle. Currently the dialog listener cannot catch it; not a functional defect, just a testability gap.
critical_code_review_comments: Buttons on home render with textTransform uppercase via CSS, so innerText is uppercase ('CRIAR PERFIL' etc). Functionally correct — labels match spec, just worth knowing for future text assertions.
battle.tsx is ~550 lines (Battle screen + PlayModal + CardEditInline + helpers). Consider splitting PlayModal & ChatBubble into their own files for maintainability (still under 700-line guideline).
seed_data_creation: Test created 1 profile (Naruto Test / Yukigakure), 1 card (Rasengan with Ck cost=5), and 1 CT (Kakashi rank S, Atk/Def/Ag/Ck/Hp=8/7/9/6/10) in AsyncStorage. These persisted across reload — main agent may want to clear AsyncStorage before further demos.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run mobile viewport 390x844. Use Playwright dialog handler for window-level alerts (Modo Online button), but note Alert.alert with multiple buttons (Encerrar confirm, delete confirms) renders as in-DOM RN-Web modal, not window.confirm. Use the testIDs from review_request. The first match-type chip 1x1 is default; for boss matches use match-1xBoss/2xBoss/3xBoss.
